notes: Sentences: Enter = ↵ a new LINE inside the same caption (blue ↵ in the row; Enter on the same spot removes it; Cmd+Enter = done). Words: Enter stays «new caption». Clicking a word in Sentences moves the playhead there. A click on the timeline / the picture takes the caret out of the text, so Space plays instead of typing a space. ✨ Generated layer: Seedance pieces sit on their own lane «✨ Generated» under Picture (purple) and as a purple strip on the picture — click a piece to switch it off (original picture back) or on; 👁 = all off / all on to compare; right-click — ▶ watch the piece. 📅 Dates: newest models — Seedance 2.5 Turbo (default), 2.5 Flash Turbo (cheaper, 480p upscaled), full 2.5, 2.0 Fast Turbo. 📐 «середній план мовця»: Seedance reframes the piece into a medium close-up of the speaker, like a new camera angle — a wide two-shot hides the patch badly. Words view highlights dates (yellow) and ✦ accent words too, like Sentences. ✦ Accent is now a full style of its own: Style → ✦ Accent — colour or gradient, any font, italic, size 80–160 %, case, stroke (as the caption / own / none), shadow (as the caption / own / none), a plate under the word. «Взяти вигляд з…» borrows a preset's look (font, colours, stroke, shadow, plate) without its size, position or case. The caption keeps its own layout; karaoke never repaints an accent word; the accent is saved with the preset. In Sentences the second button is now «🎨 Окремий титр» — a phrase as its own caption in another preset.
